description: Convert numbers to Roman numerals (1–3,999 in standard form; up to 3,999,999 with a vinculum bar, which multiplies by 1,000) and Roman numerals back to numbers with strict validation that explains mistakes (IIII, IC, VV, non-standard forms like IIX…) and the symbol-by-symbol working. Also writes a date in Roman numerals (day/month/year order and separator of your choice, years 1–3999). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/roman-numerals/

mode.description: to_roman (number → Roman), from_roman (Roman → number) or date.

order.description: date: order of day, month, year.

name: calc_roman
title: Roman numerals
